text:
Not quite: a pause can only last up to **3 months**, so a full 6-month pause isn't possible. You can pause from "Account" > "Subscriptions", or you could cancel instead (there's no cancellation fee or minimum term) and sign up again when you're back.

Timing matters: changes made before the **25th** affect the next box, while changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box. Any box that's already been billed is still sent and isn't refunded.

If you'd like to look at other options for a longer absence, I can escalate this to a Support Lead.
